name: Google Calendar
description: List your calendars, read their events and see the family's week from any session, through your Google account. Every change to an event waits for your confirm.

connections.why: Reads your calendars and events, and creates, changes and deletes events, each change only after you confirm it on a card.

settings.label: Google account
settings.description: The email of the connected account to use; empty means the first connected Google account.
